- [Native development](native-development.md)

Machine-readable contracts live under `.ai/contracts`:

- HTTP routes and trust boundaries: `.ai/contracts/http.yaml`
- NATS subjects and delivery semantics: `.ai/contracts/events.yaml`
- PostgreSQL ownership and migration risks: `.ai/contracts/database.yaml`
- Sibling service integrations: `.ai/contracts/integrations.yaml`

Reusable curriculum documentation belongs to `ms-go-course`; reusable practice-task catalog documentation belongs to `ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator`; workspace and live-validation documentation belongs to `ms-go-sandbox`.

- [Hybrid V1 intent and safe application](hybrid-replanning-v1.md) — learner-owned revision-bound consent and atomic future-only application.

- [Infrastructure acceptance fixtures](infrastructure-acceptance-fixtures.md) — root-owned T18/T202 actual producer/consumer proofs and isolated fixture guards.
